name: University of East London
description:
Would you like to study at a UK university with a rich connection to the Olympic Games?

Do you dream of studying in Englandâ€™s capital city, where British films are made and you are connected to the world-famous West End?

The University of East London offers you this opportunity, plus a whole lot more! 

The University of East London has a majority percentage of international students, situated in one of the most multicultural areas of the UK.

Students at UEL make a global impact: the university has received over Â£ 1.4 million in research funding to study youth cybercrime and child online harms in the UK, EU and Africa since 2020. 

The University of East London has an array of impressive stats! 

  • UEL researchers carried out the largest survey of youth cybercrime in the EU ever undertaken, with 8000 respondents in 8 countries taking part 
  • 92% of UEL's overall research is distinguished as world-leading, internationally excellent or internationally recognised according to the REF
  • Ranked 851 in QS World University Rankings by TopUniversities

About the University

The University of East London is based at three campuses across the east of the capital, in Stratford and Docklands. It originally opened in 1898 as the West Ham Technical Institute, gaining university status and its current name in 1992. It has around 25,000 students a year including international students from 135 different countries.

The university has been ranked in the worldâ€™s top young 200 universities. Itâ€™s also been ranked highly in the UK for its psychology research, architecture and civil engineering and top for international support and visa advice. Itâ€™s also one of the only London-based universities to offer on-campus accommodation.

Student Life

There are 26 sports clubs as part of the 90 student societies run at the University of East London. The freshers' fair is an excellent opportunity to make new friends and find exciting hobbies. The University of East London Students' Union (UELSU) runs a packed social calendar of events throughout the year, including quiz nights, comedy evenings, karaoke, and games.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of East London (UEL) originally launched in 1898 as the West Ham Technical Institute, gaining university status and its current name in 1992. UEL houses around 40,000 students from over 160 countries.

The University has been ranked among the world's top 200 young universities. It's also been ranked highly in the UK for psychology research, architecture and civil engineering, and is well-known for international support and visa advice.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: You can choose from 26 sports clubs as part of the 90 student societies run at UEL. The freshers' fair is an excellent opportunity to make new friends and find exciting hobbies. The University of East London Students' Union (UELSU) runs a packed social calendar of events throughout the year, including quiz nights, comedy evenings, karaoke, and games.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
UEL offers campus living to international students on the UEL Docklands campus. The University offers accommodation in both East and West Halls, featuring ensuite rooms and shared kitchen living spaces as standard, with 24-hour security.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
There's a 24/7 Docklands library located close to the campus. It is a stimulating space for study with friendly staff and provides a comprehensive collection of resources.

Sports
Amongst the world-class facilities at UEL is Sports Dock, a £21 million sports facility. LeBron James has trained here, as has Team USA, which used it as their training base for the London 2012 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Laboratory
There are multiple facilities, including three EEG labs, a brain stimulation lab, a Virtual Reality (VR) Lab, and many more.

Cafeteria
There are cafés, eateries, and a late bar at the Docklands campus. The Stratford campus features a restaurant and a Students' Union café-bar.

highlights.title: Reviews
highlights.value:
Aisha Khan
March 15, 2024
★★★★★
The professors are really cool, and the campus is beautiful. There’s always something fun to do, and I’ve made friends from all over. I’m so glad I chose University of East London!

Sana Rahman
January 25, 2024
★★★★★
Studying here has been a rewarding experience. The courses are challenging but worth it, and the professors are incredibly supportive. I love how inclusive the campus is, and I’ve made some great friends.

Sameera Ansari
March 5, 2024
★★★☆☆
My time at University of East London has been alright. The professors are good, but sometimes the support services take too long to respond. The campus is generally nice, though it can get really crowded during exams. Overall, it’s a decent university, but it could be better.

Arjun Verma
May 8, 2024
★★★★★
UEL is awesome. The campus is student-friendly, and the teachers really care about our success. I’ve had a great time here, and I’m happy with my choice.

Meera Nair
February 28, 2024
★★★★☆
Overall, I’ve had a solid experience. The academics are strong, and the professors are knowledgeable. Campus life is vibrant, but I faced a few hiccups initially. Still, I’d recommend this place to anyone looking for a good university experience.

Rajesh Patel
April 22, 2024
★★★★★
University of East London is a great place to study. The facilities are good, and the courses are really helpful. The teachers are supportive, and I’ve learned so much that will help me in my career.

Fatima Siddiqui
February 20, 2024
★★★★★
My experience here has been amazing. The campus is modern, and the learning environment is dynamic. The courses are tailored to industry needs, and the professors are experts in their fields. I’ve gained a lot of knowledge and made lifelong friends.

Vikram Singh
October 12, 2023
★★★☆☆
The University of East London is decent, but there are areas that need improvement. While the courses are informative, the administration could be more organized. Some facilities also need upgrading. It's not a bad place to study, but there's definitely room for improvement.

Ravi Shankar
March 30, 2024
★★★★★
The atmosphere at this university is really positive. The balance between academics and social activities is just right. The staff are always approachable, and I’ve had countless opportunities to develop my skills and network with others.

Zainab Ali
February 10, 2024
★★★★★
UEL has been a fantastic experience. The diversity here is amazing, and everyone is so friendly. The support from the university is excellent, and I feel ready for the future.
